title: Hold a run behind the runs of its serial key input
description: A Submitted run names a serial key and a live run with that key was submitted before it: the run is WaitingOnKey, and nothing of it is started or copied. The view of the run says `waiting on key <k> behind run <id>` (key_wait). The daemon looks again whenever a run of the key leaves its live states and issues TakeKey once no live run with the key was submitted before this one; a cancel takes the run out of the queue. A restarted daemon keeps the run WaitingOnKey: the queue is the runs of the key in the journal's order. The daemon also writes the run event `runbook.waiting-on-key` (record: serial_key, behind: the run ahead at that moment); see CancelRun for why it is stated here. Issued by the daemon itself (actor DaemonProcess): it has no route in the HTTP contract.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.
